cpo.beta_rationale: β is the preference-pressure scalar (global reward-scale knob). At 2.0, the gradient correction on preference reversals is moderate but the base model's generosity prior is not fully overridden on disqualification tasks (18% false-negative rate observed). Diagnostic sweep recommended before changing: [1.0, 1.5, 2.0].
cpo.loss_type_note: Plain CPO — no length normalization, no target margin. Named train_simpo.py but SimPO config not applied. To enable SimPO margin: set loss_type=simpo and gamma_beta_ratio=0.4 after running output-length diagnostic.

simpo_next_run.prerequisite: Equalize PASS/FAIL output lengths in build_simpo_pairs.py first — PASS verdicts avg 11 tokens, FAIL avg 54 tokens (4.9x asymmetry causes structural PASS bias under length normalization)
